script.title: The mysterious red lightning that shoots into space
script.description: Discover the terrifying science of sprites and gigantic jets that blast from storm clouds into the edge of space.

shots.narration: Gigantic jets of red lightning shoot upward into space from storm clouds.
These mysterious discharges ignite fifty kilometers above the ground in the cold mesosphere.
A single jellyfish sprite can stretch fifty kilometers wide across the sky.
The intense flash would instantly blind your unprotected retinas from close range.
They begin as fast ionization balls plunging at ten percent light speed.
This electrical avalanche triggers in less than ten milliseconds above the storm.
Your heart would stop if you felt this cold plasma energy field.
Unlike hot lightning, these space sprites are actually cold like fluorescent tubes.
Blue jets also blast upward from cloud tops at incredible speeds.
The freezing air would instantly crystallize the moisture on your bare skin.
Shorter blue starters only reach twenty kilometers high before fading away completely.
Gigantic jets accelerate to over two thousand kilometers per second into space.
The sudden shockwave would rupture your eardrums if you were up there.
One powerful upward blast once ripped a heavy NASA research payload apart.
